summary: Bentley Systems filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on May 21, 2026. Items included election of directors, advisory vote on executive compensation, and ratification of KPMG as auditor. All proposals passed. The company also announced a $0.07 per share quarterly dividend declared on May 22, 2026, payable June 11, 2026 to holders of record June 2, 2026. This is a routine current report containing standard shareholder meeting outcomes and a dividend declaration, neither of which constitutes a special situation event.
